The table shows the average annual salary for four jobs.

Average Annual Salaries

| Job                | Average Annual Salary (dollars) |
|--------------------|--------------------------------|
| Copywriter         | 55,869                         |
| Librarian          | 54,407                         |
| Elevator technician | 71,900                         |
| Aircraft mechanic  | 52,975                         |

Based on this information, how much more will an elevator technician make than a librarian over 10 years?
